svg.title: Dense cross-attention field-to-LLM interface
svg.desc: Stage 1 aligns field and numerical-text representations. Stage 2 builds content and exact-value memory for every field cell and injects gated dense cross-attention after frozen Qwen layers 8, 20, and 32. Inference reuses the fixed memory and bridges.

g.text: CAℓ: gated cross-attention after layer ℓ
